entries.reason: Single Responsibility — The draft is scoped to one bugfix: preventing finalize-merge from stopping when only flow management metadata remains dirty after finalize-commit.; Unambiguous Requirements — 小さな chore commit — “小さな” is a vague adjective and does not state a verifiable condition for the commit size or content. (at $.analysis.proposedApproach); Unambiguous Requirements — 小さな chore commit — This requirement uses the vague adjective “小さな” without measurable criteria, so reviewers could not verify that the condition is satisfied. (at $.scopeVerification.in[0]); Complete Context — 必要最小限の fixture — “必要最小限” is subjective and lacks measurable criteria, so two independent reviewers may not agree on what fixture scope satisfies it. (at $.decisionMap.deferredToSpec[1]); No Hardcoded Secrets — The draft contains no source code and no API keys, passwords, tokens, or other hardcoded secrets.; Prioritize Requirements — The in-scope requirements number more than three and each item is assigned a priority of must or should.; Impact on Existing Features — The draft includes an impactOnExisting section listing impacts on finalize-merge behavior, dirty worktree stopping, downstream reset handling, and CLI command compatibility.; Present Recommendations with Reasoning — The single question includes a recommended answer first and provides concise reasoning grounded in existing code patterns and observed behavior.; Explore Before Asking — The draft records codebase evidence from registry, finalize, next-action, and merge modules before asking the user question.; Proactively Raise Related Implications — The draft proactively raises implications for dirty file scope, user work safety, downstream reset handling, and CLI argument compatibility.; Confirm Brainstorm vs. Decision Before Critiquing — The draft does not critique brainstorming ideas as final decisions; it records an answered goal-confirmation question and an approved direction.; Capture Digressions in draft.md — No discussion digression is present in the provided content, so the guardrail is inapplicable by nature of the draft.; Backward-Compatible CLI Interface — The draft explicitly states that user-facing CLI arguments and existing command names are not changed, so no migration plan is required.
Draft gate failed because vague adjectives made commit scope and fixture scope non-verifiable.
entries.resolution: Rewrote the draft to specify exact staged paths and the three fixture cases.

entries.reason: Spec review found undefined precedence between external dirty paths and downstream skipped reset.
entries.resolution: Added an explicit rule that target-external dirty paths block all finalize-merge pre-hook metadata mutation and commit, including downstream reset.

entries.reason: fix: spec-local git status assertions now use --untracked-files=all
entries.resolution: gate artifact failed because git status --short collapses untracked directories; file-level dirty assertions need untracked file expansion

entries.reason: R1 — finalize-merge pre hook now preflights dirty paths and commits current spec flow.json/issue-log.json metadata when no external dirty paths exist, before runPreSync would run.; R2 — Metadata staging is limited to allowedMetadataPaths for current spec flow.json and issue-log.json; any external dirty path causes skip with no git add.; R3 — finalize-merge pre hook reads git status before mutation, returns immediately on any non-allowed dirty path, so it neither commits metadata nor runs downstream skipped reset; spec-local test covers this behavior.; R4 — finalize-merge pre hook now skips external-dirty cases, resets downstream skipped steps when safe, stages flow.json via includeFlowJson, and commits before pre-sync.; R5 — Spec-local test file added under specs/263-fix-finalize-merge-dirty/tests with // spec: R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 header and tests covering metadata-only dirty commit, target-external dirty no-op, and downstream skipped reset behavior.; Spec Test Coverage — The diff adds spec-local coverage under specs/263-fix-finalize-merge-dirty/tests/ with a non-empty // spec: R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 header.; Avoid Overengineering — function finalizeMergeMetadataPaths(specId) — This newly introduced helper is only called by getFinalizeMergeAllowedMetadataPaths in the diff, making it an indirection layer with a single caller. (at src/flow/lib/run-finalize.js); Avoid Overengineering — function collectPorcelainStatusPaths(output) — This newly introduced helper is only called by readFinalizeMergeDirtyPaths in the diff, making it an indirection layer with a single caller. (at src/flow/lib/run-finalize.js); Avoid Overengineering — export function readFinalizeMergeDirtyPaths({ root }) — This newly introduced exported helper only wraps collectPorcelainStatusPaths(readFinalizeMergeStatusOutput(root)) and has no shown caller in the diff, adding an unnecessary indirection surface. (at src/flow/lib/run-finalize.js)
fix: removed single-caller helpers flagged by no-overengineering
entries.resolution: inlined finalize metadata path construction and removed the unused dirty-path export and its single-caller collector
